scope: Twenty publication route records mapped to exact staged source-located candidate interfaces, plus checked-conditional terminal quartet and direct predecessor endpoints. Not a whole-paper proof audit or a claim of manuscript/formal equivalence.

records.title: Residual partition
records.label: px:2.1
records.scope_summary: A supplied, single-valued reduction map.
records.mapping_status: source-located candidate interface; no machine-certified manuscript equivalence asserted
records.review_notes: The three source theorems express exhaustive, unique and disjoint fibers for a supplied reduction map. No arithmetic reduction-map existence is asserted.

records.title: No crossing under positive-depth perturbation
records.label: px:2.2
records.scope_summary: Root-preserving operations. The infinite statement assumes convergence.
records.mapping_status: source-located candidate interface; no machine-certified manuscript equivalence asserted
records.review_notes: Finite reachability assumes root preservation; infinite statement uses explicit finite-precision convergence. positive_depth_mod is a natural-number example bridge, not a general adic-arithmetic theorem.

records.title: Zeroth-order obstruction
records.label: px:2.3
records.scope_summary: Different roots cannot be reached by genuine positive-depth operations.
records.mapping_status: source-located candidate interface; no machine-certified manuscript equivalence asserted
records.review_notes: Publication route SeedBoundary is navigation/context; the direct general obstruction is owned by Residual. SeedBoundary instead contains infinite-graph source-count counterexamples.

records.title: Formal inverse-limit reconstruction
records.label: px:3.2
records.scope_summary: Represented complete local problems with compatible finite maps.
records.mapping_status: source-located candidate interface; no machine-certified manuscript equivalence asserted
records.review_notes: Main endpoint reconstructs a unique local continuous coefficient-preserving algebra hom from a compatible family; localReconstructionEquiv gives the local-ring-hom bijection. Representability is assumed externally. ReconstructionLocal is related twisting/locality support rather than the reconstruction endpoint.

records.title: Finite-branch compactness
records.label: px:3.3
records.scope_summary: Finite nonempty levels and the stated total reduction maps.
records.mapping_status: source-located candidate interface; no machine-certified manuscript equivalence asserted
records.review_notes: FiniteLevels of a supplied Tower plus nonempty all levels yields a Branch. Tower includes total reduction maps. This is conditional finite-set compactness.

records.title: Smooth formal branch count
records.label: px:3.4
records.scope_summary: An actual power-series chart and coefficient-preserving local maps.
records.mapping_status: source-located candidate interface; no machine-certified manuscript equivalence asserted
records.review_notes: smooth_model_count is the supplied algebra-isomorphism transfer of the actual power-series point count. Its owner SmoothModels is a source-bearing adjunct beyond the published SmoothMaps/IntegralCharts routes. integralPointEquiv and modelDigitEquiv support the integral-branch and residue-stream clauses; no representability/chart isomorphism is manufactured.

records.title: Cohomology packet decomposition
records.label: px:4.2
records.scope_summary: A finite complete orthogonal family of chain projectors.
records.mapping_status: source-located candidate interface; no machine-certified manuscript equivalence asserted
records.review_notes: These are definitions producing linear equivalences, not theorem declarations. The genuine graded-complex endpoint is chainCohomologyPacketEquiv; cohomologyPacketEquiv uses the custom three-term complex interface. Both require the finite complete orthogonal projectors.

records.title: Weighted smooth-chart count
records.label: px:5.3
records.scope_summary: Independent coordinates with the stated valuation lower bounds.
records.mapping_status: source-located candidate interface; no machine-certified manuscript equivalence asserted
records.review_notes: Counts independent actual ideal-quotient tuples. count_via_chart transfers counts only with a separately supplied chart equivalence. Nat subtraction is truncated and matches max(m-w,0).

records.title: Smooth seed zeta function
records.label: px:6.2
records.scope_summary: The smooth-chart count, as an infinite formal power series.
records.mapping_status: source-located candidate interface; no machine-certified manuscript equivalence asserted
records.review_notes: smooth_model_zeta counts actual coefficient-algebra maps conditional on a supplied formal-model algebra isomorphism; actual_smooth_zeta is the ideal-chart series formula. Both are infinite formal power series.

records.title: Weighted seed zeta function
records.label: px:6.3
records.scope_summary: The stated ordered positive weights, with finite initial levels separated.
records.mapping_status: source-located candidate interface; no machine-certified manuscript equivalence asserted
records.review_notes: actual_weighted_zeta uses a supplied upper bound M on all weights, a truncated initial polynomial, and an explicit geometric tail. The manuscript specializes M to maximal weight and rewrites its coefficient; static mapping does not certify that algebraic rewrite.

records.title: Singular power seed
records.label: px:6.4
records.scope_summary: The scalar equation x to the e equals zero at finite precision.
records.mapping_status: source-located candidate interface; no machine-certified manuscript equivalence asserted
records.review_notes: The first endpoint counts actual roots over a finite-residue DVR; the second gives the actual-root formal-series identity. e>0 is retained.

records.title: Fractional singular dimension
records.label: px:6.6
records.scope_summary: A finite-count growth exponent, not the dimension of a limit space.
records.mapping_status: source-located candidate interface; no machine-certified manuscript equivalence asserted
records.review_notes: The endpoint is the actual logarithmic finite-level counting limit. compatible_root_family_zero separately proves every compatible integral root tower is zero; counting dimension is not branch-space dimension.

records.title: Directed minimum-seed theorem
records.label: px:7.3
records.scope_summary: A finite supplied graph. Arithmetic admissibility of edges is separate.
records.mapping_status: source-located candidate interface; no machine-certified manuscript equivalence asserted
records.review_notes: Finite supplied directed graph only. Source counts and minimum seed rank do not establish any arithmetic transport graph or admissibility.

records.title: Adelic finite-depth completion
records.label: px:8.2
records.scope_summary: Common data, finite-depth nonemptiness, and inverse-limit-closed conditions.
records.mapping_status: source-located candidate interface; no machine-certified manuscript equivalence asserted
records.review_notes: ConditionalArithmeticSpine.adelic_finite_depth_completion packages the full spine (including determinant/local realization) and is reached through later route closure; ClassCommonSpine provides a polynomial/local-condition predecessor. Explicit finite-level occupancy, continuity and inverse-limit closure remain hypotheses.

records.title: Residual companion obstruction
records.label: px:8.3
records.scope_summary: An empty required finite level rules out the specified realization.
records.mapping_status: source-located candidate interface; no machine-certified manuscript equivalence asserted
records.review_notes: Publication route SpineCompletionBoundary supplies explanatory countermodels, not this general endpoint. General framed system obstruction is SystemCompletion.system_empty_level_obstruction, with abstract indexed-tower obstruction in Compactness. The source for a literal full-spine class formulation should be checked separately if exact manuscript equivalence is claimed.

records.title: Finite Frobenius separation
records.label: px:9.1
records.scope_summary: Later constructed rational-base separator, with its literal compatible-family inputs.
records.mapping_status: source-located candidate interface; no machine-certified manuscript equivalence asserted
records.review_notes: Constructed occurrence discharges the external API premise; supplied compatible irreducible constituents, character continuity, good-prime compatibility and nonisomorphism remain explicit hypotheses. No universal arithmetic-system existence is concluded.

records.title: Compatible-carrier summand completion
records.label: px:9.2
records.scope_summary: Explicit copy presentations, natural multiplicities within capacity, and supplied local data.
records.mapping_status: source-located candidate interface; no machine-certified manuscript equivalence asserted
records.review_notes: Endpoint requires supplied actual carrier-copy and initial-summand-copy equivariant presentations, multiplicity capacity, trace separator and local packets/comparisons. It proves recovery and finite-copy closure, not those inputs.

records.title: Exact finite occupancy trace
records.label: px:10.1
records.scope_summary: Commuting split semisimple operators. The positive-trace interpretation uses characteristic zero.
records.mapping_status: source-located candidate interface; no machine-certified manuscript equivalence asserted
records.review_notes: Projector, field-trace dimension equality, unique natural trace preimage, and occupancy via positive natural trace are separate endpoints. CharZero is needed for trace detection/uniqueness, while trace_eq_dimension itself is field-valued and works in any characteristic.

records.title: Residual-system completion criterion
records.label: px:11.1
records.scope_summary: The later amended two-conjunct contract, not universal residual existence.
records.mapping_status: source-located candidate interface; no machine-certified manuscript equivalence asserted
records.review_notes: Use manuscript/conditional_completion.tex as the selected amended reading contract. Terminal is a conjunction: an indexed transported family from already completed source members, and pointwise carrier recovery for a separately supplied compatible packet/carrier at arbitrary l0. It does not identify these two families, prove all-place carrier presentations, or force nonzero selected multiplicities.

records.title: Exact location of the remaining existence problem
records.label: px:11.2
records.scope_summary: All required finite levels and all supplied packet occupancy premises.
records.mapping_status: source-located candidate interface; no machine-certified manuscript equivalence asserted
records.review_notes: Conditional finite-level/system/occupancy boundary with explicit witnesses. The required packet carriers may be different supplied spaces and are not identified with the completed system.

theorem adelic_finite_depth_completion
    (O : Λ → Type) [∀ l, CommRing (O l)]
    (I : (l : Λ) → Ideal (O l)) [∀ l, IsAdicComplete (I l) (O l)]
    (hI : ∀ l, (I l).FG) [∀ l, Finite (O l ⧸ I l)]
    (C : (l : Λ) → ClassConditions (G := G) (ι := ι) (I l))
    (finite : ∀ l k, 0 < k → Finite {c // (C l).allowed k c})
    (occupied : ∀ l k, 0 < k → ∃ c, (C l).allowed k c)
    (continuous : ∀ l k c, (C l).allowed k c →
      ∃ ρ, classOf ρ = c ∧ FiniteRepContinuous ρ)
    (inc : (l : Λ) → O l →+* K l)
    (hinc : ∀ l, @Continuous (O l) (K l) (I l).adicTopology inferInstance (inc l))
    (emb : (l : Λ) → E →+* K l)
    (S : Spine (G := G) (ι := ι) (V := V) (E := E) K)
    (closed : ∀ l, InverseLimitClosed (I l) (C l)
      (fun ρ => LocalRealizes S l (changeCoefficients (inc l) ρ)))
    (localP : (l : Λ) → V → Polynomial (O l))
    (poly_integral : ∀ l v, S.good l v →
      (localP l v).map (inc l) = (S.polynomial v).map (emb l))
    (poly_spec : ∀ l k c, (C l).allowed k c → ∀ v, S.good l v →
      classCharpoly c (S.sample v) = (localP l v).map (Ideal.Quotient.mk ((I l)^k)))
    (localDet : (l : Λ) → G → O l)
    (det_integral : ∀ l g, inc l (localDet l g) = S.determinant l g)
    (det_spec : ∀ l k c, (C l).allowed k c → ∀ g,
      classDet c g = Ideal.Quotient.mk ((I l)^k) (localDet l g)) :
    ∃ ρ : (l : Λ) → MatrixRep (O l) G ι,
      (∀ l k, (C l).allowed k (classOf (reduce (I l) (ρ l) k))) ∧
      (∀ l, Continuous (changeCoefficients (inc l) (ρ l))) ∧
      RealizesSpine S emb (fun l => changeCoefficients (inc l) (ρ l))

theorem unframed_common_spine_completion
    {Λ G ι V E : Type} [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    [Field E] (O K : Λ → Type) [∀ l, CommRing (O l)] [∀ l, Field (K l)]
    [∀ l, TopologicalSpace (K l)]
    (I : (l : Λ) → Ideal (O l)) [∀ l, IsAdicComplete (I l) (O l)]
    (hI : ∀ l, (I l).FG) [∀ l, Finite (O l ⧸ I l)]
    (C : (l : Λ) → ClassConditions (G := G) (ι := ι) (I l))
    (finite : ∀ l k, 0 < k → Finite {c // (C l).allowed k c})
    (occupied : ∀ l k, 0 < k → ∃ c, (C l).allowed k c)
    (continuous : ∀ l k c, (C l).allowed k c →
      ∃ ρ, classOf ρ = c ∧ FiniteRepContinuous ρ)
    (inc : (l : Λ) → O l →+* K l)
    (hinc : ∀ l, @Continuous (O l) (K l) (I l).adicTopology inferInstance (inc l))
    (emb : (l : Λ) → E →+* K l)
    (Local : (l : Λ) → MatrixRep (K l) G ι → Prop)
    (stable : ∀ l ρ, (∀ k, (C l).allowed k (classOf (reduce (I l) ρ k))) →
      Local l (changeCoefficients (inc l) ρ))
    (sample : V → G) (good : Λ → V → Prop)
    (P : V → Polynomial E) (localP : (l : Λ) → V → Polynomial (O l))
    (integrality : ∀ l v, good l v → (localP l v).map (inc l) = (P v).map (emb l))
    (spec : ∀ l k c, (C l).allowed k c → ∀ v, good l v →
      classCharpoly c (sample v) = (localP l v).map (Ideal.Quotient.mk ((I l)^k))) :

theorem compatible_carrier_summand_completion
    {K : Type u} [Field K] [CharZero K] [TopologicalSpace K]
    {GG : Type v} [Monoid GG] [TopologicalSpace GG]
    {I : Type} [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]
    {V : I → Type u}
    [∀ i, AddCommGroup (V i)] [∀ i, Module K (V i)]
    [∀ i, FiniteDimensional K (V i)] [∀ i, TopologicalSpace (V i)]
    (ρ : ∀ i, Representation K GG (V i))
    (hρ : ∀ i, Continuous (fun gx : GG × V i => ρ i gx.1 gx.2))
    {W : Type z} [AddCommGroup W] [Module K W]
    (carrier : Representation K GG W)
    (m c : I → ℕ) (hmc : ∀ i, m i ≤ c i)
    (Bcar : W ≃ₗ[K] Copies V c)
    (hBcar : ∀ g x, Bcar (carrier g x) = copiesRep ρ c g (Bcar x))
    {U₀ : Type z} [AddCommGroup U₀] [Module K U₀]
    [FiniteDimensional K U₀]
    (ρU₀ : Representation K GG U₀)
    (e₀ : U₀ ≃ₗ[K] Copies V m)
    (he₀ : ∀ g x, e₀ (ρU₀ g x) = copiesRep ρ m g (e₀ x))
    (sample : I → GG)
    (hdet : Matrix.det (fun j i => LinearMap.trace K _ (ρ i (sample j))) ≠ 0)
    {E : Type uB} [CommRing E] (σE : E →+* K)
    (g : GG) (P : I → E[X])
    (hP : ∀ i, (ρ i g).charpoly = (P i).map σE)
    {GW : Type v} [Group GW] [TopologicalSpace GW]
    {ν : GW →* Kˣ} (H : Subgroup GW) [H.Normal]
    (D : ∀ i, InertialDatum (ν := ν) H (V i)) (φ : GW)
    {Bper : Type uB} [Field Bper] [Algebra K Bper]
    {GP : Type v} [Group GP]
    (σB : GP →* (Bper ≃ₐ[K] Bper)) (tate : ℤ → GP →* Kˣ)
    (ρp : ∀ i, Representation K GP (V i))
    (C : ∀ i, Comparison σB tate (ρp i)) :
    (∃ j : Representation.IntertwiningMap ρU₀ carrier,
      ∃ r : Representation.IntertwiningMap carrier ρU₀,
        ∀ x, r (j x) = x) ∧
    (∀ n : I → ℕ,
      (∀ j, LinearMap.trace K U₀ (ρU₀ (sample j)) =
        LinearMap.trace K _ (copiesRep ρ n (sample j))) → n = m) ∧
    (∃ j : Representation.IntertwiningMap (copiesRep ρ m) carrier,
      ∃ r : Representation.IntertwiningMap carrier (copiesRep ρ m),
        (∀ x, r (j x) = x) ∧
        Continuous (fun gx : GG × Copies V m => copiesRep ρ m gx.1 gx.2) ∧
        (copiesRep ρ m g).charpoly = (∏ i, P i ^ m i).map σE) ∧
    (let S := copiesInertialDatum H D m;
      S.toDatum = copiesDatum (fun i => (D i).toDatum) m ∧
      localCharpoly S.toDatum H φ =
        ∏ i, localCharpoly (D i).toDatum H φ ^ m i ∧
      eulerPolynomial S.toDatum H φ =
        ∏ i, eulerPolynomial (D i).toDatum H φ ^ m i ∧
      Module.finrank K (fixedKernel S.toDatum H) =
        ∑ i, m i * Module.finrank K (fixedKernel (D i).toDatum H) ∧
      LinearMap.trace K _ (fixedRep S.toDatum H φ) =
        ∑ i, (m i : K) * LinearMap.trace K _ (fixedRep (D i).toDatum H φ)) ∧
    (∃ Csel : Comparison σB tate (copiesRep ρp m),
      (∀ z : ℤ,
        weightMultiplicity σB tate Csel z =
          ∑ i, m i * weightMultiplicity σB tate (C i) z) ∧
      (∀ z : ℤ, Nonempty (
        periodSpace σB tate (copiesRep ρp m) z ≃ₗ[K]
          Copies (fun i => periodSpace σB tate (ρp i) z) m)))
